messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary deploy finished: release/2026.03.15 sticky-affinity change applied to cohort "canary-ingress". Traffic shift 2%.

riley_t: got paged. seeing elevated 502s from inference-runner canary in us-east-1. Alert shows surge in tail latencies and 502s.

nina_s: looking at graphs — p95 latency up from 140ms -> 980ms for canary hosts, error rate ~2.2% overall but some backends at 7%. Link: https://dd.example.com/dash/sticky-canary

sam_k: that looks like session affinity mismatch — sticky cookie domain was set to .example.local in the canary ingress. If older infra expects region-specific cookie, sessions may land on mismatched backends.

riley_t: confirmed pods returning errors contain logs with "session lookup failed: affinity_miss". snippet:

```
WARN affinity: cookie domain mismatch: got ".example.local", expected ".us-east-1.example.local"
ERROR route: affinity_miss -> returning 502
```

sam_k: recommend immediate flip of feature flag to disable new sticky-affinity behavior for canary cohort: feature-flag sticky_affinity_v2

nina_s: agree. Also scale canary down to 0 to stop leakage while we fix cookie scoping. ops command:

```
opsctl feature-flag set sticky_affinity_v2 --cohort=canary-ingress --value=false --reason="affinity leak 2026-03-15"
kubectl -n ingress scale deploy ingress-canary --replicas=0
```

deploy-bot: Triggered rollback checklist? None yet. Would you like me to pause rollout? (yes/no)

riley_t: pause rollout and stop further traffic shifts.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for release/2026.03.15. No further canary promotion.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-319. Severity: P2. PagerDuty alerted. Owner: riley_t.

nina_s: opsctl returned 200. scaling in progress. watching metrics.

sam_k: once scaled, error rate should drop. we should also patch the ingress template to use region-aware cookie domain and add unit tests for cookie scoping.

riley_t: error rate dropped from 2.2% -> 0.4% in 2m. Good. CS: any customer impact reports?

cs_agent: CS sees ~6 tickets opened in last hour from customers hitting 502s; all in us-east region. I've flagged high-touch accounts.

riley_t: assign customer comms to cs_agent and nina_s for a short note. I'll own technical rollback and PR.

nina_s: preparing a short incident update for #incidents. will include mitigation steps and next steps: patch ingress templates, add e2e for cookie scoping, full rollback PR.

sam_k: I created PR to revert sticky-affinity change and add a template fix: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/infra/merge/3510. Please review.

riley_t: reviewing PR now. once merged we'll coordinate a controlled rollback. Do not promote new kernel or affinity until signoff.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: riley_t -> nina_s for next 2-hour window (03:10-05:10 UTC).

incident-bot: Update: mitigation applied (feature-flag kill-switch + scaled canary to 0). Status: monitoring. Next steps: PR review, patch deploy to infra-staging, customer comms.

nina_s: posting summary in #incidents now. CS will send an initial outreach to affected accounts with "intermittent 502s" and note mitigation.

riley_t: good job team — quick flip minimized blast radius. Postmortem items: ingress template tests, add canary smoke that validates cookie scoping, add a deploy-time check for cookie domain.

cs_agent: sending queued messages to affected customers. will escalate if we get enterprise cases.

nina_s: incident will remain open until PR merged and staging smoke verified. closing pager for now.

riley_t: thanks, closing up from my side. keep updates here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
